summary: Leads examined while wiring disconnected Causality results to the designated root route and dropped. STMT-NO-INFINITE-PER-SE-EFFICIENT-CAUSE-SERIES: from STMT-GROUNDING-WITH-UNIQUE-CAUSE-YIELDS-REGRESS-READING it needs three new open antecedents (every per se power finitely grounded, sources receive no link, at most one immediate per se cause), and from STMT-REGRESS-READINGS-COINCIDE-CLASSICALLY a new literal-reading statement; both steps are modus ponens on a proved conditional or equivalence (single application, invariant 16) and the premise is stated, so neither lowers a route cost. STMT-CAUSE-OF-QUALITY-IN-ANOTHER-IS-MORE-SUCH: STMT-CAUSE-OF-BEING-HAS-WHAT-IT-GIVES is too weak, since the target quantifies over every cause of a quality, not only causes of esse. STMT-NOTHING-REDUCED-TO-ACT-EXCEPT-BY-A-MOVER: STMT-WHATEVER-IS-MOVED-IS-MOVED-BY-ANOTHER yields it only by dropping y /= x, a strength registration (not walked) of a statement itself derived from the target; STMT-NO-INERTIAL-UNIFORM-MOTION-WITHOUT-MOVER yields only the uniform-motion restriction. The necessary-root family (STMT-NECESSARY-CLASSICAL-GOD-ROOT and about 96 upstream Causality results) feeds only NECESSARY-CLASSICAL-GOD-CASE, which is not the designated root_route of STMT-CATHOLICISM-TRUE; it was left to the necessary-being worker.
blocker: The necessary-root family needs a root_route designation decision or a designated-route argument consuming STMT-UNIQUE-GOD-WITH-CLASSICAL-ATTRIBUTES-EXISTS or STMT-NECESSARY-CLASSICAL-GOD-ROOT; most remaining disconnected Causality results are controls, countermodels and model witnesses whose conclusions are not route premises by design.
